Key Takeaways
The meeting focused on designing a website with a chatbot for GCCX, emphasizing lead capture and user engagement.
Challenges addressed included balancing chatbot access with lead capture, preventing chatbot inaccuracies, and designing a user-friendly, SEO-effective website.
Follow-up actions involve sourcing interns for development, creating a tracker sheet for task management, and training a new custom GPT for the chatbot.
The team decided on a monochrome website design with red highlights, developed a structured chatbot integration plan with HubSpot, and set a two-week timeline for initial development.
